change: Replace per-connection threads and blocking I/O with a single nonblocking epoll loop and sendfile.
evidence: Baseline: 256-client medians 40,477 and 18,015 requests/s with failures; 4096-client rounds included zero throughput and hundreds of thousands of failures. All workloads ineligible; no speedup claim possible.
hypothesis: Thread-per-connection creation and virtual address space cause severe failures and stalls under the 4096-client workloads; an event loop with bounded per-connection state should avoid those limits.
next_action: Submit nonblocking design, run acceptance and complete paired measurement.
verdict: Reliability issue takes precedence over throughput.
